Religious observances for Sawan month and Hariyali Amavasya detailed

Multiple Indian media outlets provided coverage focused on religious observances during the month of Sawan and Hariyali Amavasya in 2026. Reports detailed auspicious timings, rituals, and specific prayers for Sawan Somwar (Mondays in Sawan) and Hariyali Amavasya. Specific practices mentioned include performing 'Shiva Muth' experiments, Abhishek (ritual bathing) of Shivlings with various items, and performing rituals for ancestors (Pitru Paksha) to seek blessings and prosperity. Some reports also highlighted unique astrological conjunctions occurring during these periods.
